text.en: Knowledge lasts longer than any treasure in our hands.

This prose lesson says that education stays with a person for life and is more lasting than wealth. Women's education was high in the Sangam period, declined in the middle ages and was brought back through the efforts of reformers across the world.
It honours women who excelled in learning. The lesson teaches that girls' education is important for the family and the nation.
Terms: கல்வி (education), பெண்கல்வி (women's education), சங்ககாலம் (Sangam age) and சான்றோர் (the wise).
